name: Apartmen am Waldrand
beschreibung: The Apartment Am Waldrand is peacefully situated on the outskirts of Langkampfen in the scenic Tyrolean Unterland. The property is embraced by verdant meadows and an adjacent forest, offering an extraordinarily quiet setting away from the village centre. Guests can easily reach central Langkampfen within just a few minutes by car or on foot. The apartment is functionally and comfortably appointed, featuring a fully equipped kitchen, a restful bedroom, and a private balcony overlooking nature. Convenient parking spaces are provided directly on the premises.
